# Story 01 — PLATFORM-10-WEB developer: one palette, one file — tokens and primitives, both directions (Story: CRM-25)

## Prerequisites

- **PLATFORM-9-WEB (CRM-24) completed** — the `web/` Vite + React 19 + react-router 7 + TypeScript 7 + Vitest 4 skeleton is in place. `web/src/pages/sign-in/SignInPage.tsx` and `web/src/pages/home/HomePage.tsx` were shipped intentionally unstyled so this story can convert them to the primitives (see comments at `web/src/pages/sign-in/SignInPage.tsx` lines 6–8).
- Read `.squad/plan-lessons.md` end to end before starting. L-10, L-13, L-14 and L-15 shape this plan directly:
  - L-14 — name **packages**, not versions. This story adds **no new npm dependency**; plain CSS custom properties and a two-file `i18n/` module cover the criteria.
  - L-15 — run `npm run build` in `web/`, not only `npm test`; the test runner does not typecheck the project.
  - L-10 + L-13 — the D-1 guard is a **narrow, grammar-aware CSS scan** of `web/src/**/*.css` excluding the tokens file, not a repo-wide regex over text. The repo-wide check across all three roots is **PLATFORM-15-ALL** and is explicitly out of scope.
- Coordinate with the owner of **LANGUAGES-1-WEB** before extending the `i18n/` module shape: this story ships the two resource files and the reader the primitives use; the full library and runtime switching are that story's.

## Story Goal

Ship the first (and only) palette and the smallest primitive set the web root needs, so that:

1. **Colour lives in exactly one file** — `web/src/shared/ui/tokens.css`. Nothing else in `web/src/` writes `#...`, `rgb(...)`, `hsl(...)` or a named CSS colour in a declaration. Every primitive consumes `var(--…)`.
2. **Direction is a single rule set.** Primitives use CSS logical properties (`margin-inline-*`, `padding-inline-*`, `inset-inline-*`, `text-align: start/end`). No `[dir="rtl"] …` overrides. `<html dir>` is set from the active language.
3. **User-facing text in primitives comes from resource files** — `web/src/shared/i18n/en.ts` and `web/src/shared/i18n/ar.ts` — via a `useTranslation()` reader. Both files export the same key set; a missing key in either is a **compile error**.
4. **A screen can be assembled from primitives without restating spacing, radius or type scale.** `SignInPage` and `HomePage` are rewritten to use the primitives as the proof.

**Out of scope** (leave a one-line comment in code pointing at the owner):
- Full i18n library and runtime language switching — **LANGUAGES-1-WEB**.
- Desk shell, header, theme toggle — **PLATFORM-12-WEB**.
- Empty / loading / error states (rule D-2) — **PLATFORM-16-WEB**.
- Repo-wide colour-literal check across `api, web, android` — **PLATFORM-15-ALL**.
- Dark mode / second palette. Structure the tokens so adding one later does not touch a primitive; do not add one.

- **D-1** (`scripts/rules.txt` line 40) — No colour literal outside the tokens file, in any root. This story enforces it for **`web/`** only; PLATFORM-15-ALL owns the cross-root script.

## Implementation tasks

No backend changes required.

### 1 — Create the tokens file (single source of colour, spacing, radius, type, direction)

**Create file:** `web/src/shared/ui/tokens.css`

Structure the file so a second palette can be added later without touching a primitive. One `:root` block holds every token. Group under commented banners: **Colour**, **Spacing scale**, **Radius scale**, **Type scale**, **Line heights**, **Motion**. Every colour is defined here and nowhere else.

```css
/*
 * The one palette. Every colour the web root uses lives in this file.
 * A primitive reads var(--…); it never writes #fff, rgb(...), hsl(...) or
 * a named colour. That is rule D-1 (scripts/rules.txt line 40).
 *
 * Dark mode is out of scope (PLATFORM-10-WEB); the structure allows a second
 * palette to be added under a selector without touching a primitive.
 */
:root {
  /* Colour — semantic, not raw. Raw hex only ever appears here. */
  --color-bg-page: #ffffff;
  --color-bg-surface: #f7f7f8;
  --color-text-primary: #111418;
  --color-text-muted: #55606c;
  --color-border-subtle: #d9dde2;
  --color-border-strong: #6b7683;
  --color-accent: #1f6feb;
  --color-accent-contrast: #ffffff;
  --color-danger: #b42318;
  --color-focus-ring: #1f6feb;

  /* Spacing scale — used by Stack, Card and Field. */
  --space-1: 4px;
  --space-2: 8px;
  --space-3: 12px;
  --space-4: 16px;
  --space-5: 24px;
  --space-6: 32px;

  /* Radius scale — used by Button, Input, Card. */
  --radius-sm: 4px;
  --radius-md: 8px;
  --radius-lg: 12px;

  /* Type scale — used by Text and Heading. */
  --font-family-base: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif;
  --font-size-body: 14px;
  --font-size-heading-1: 24px;
  --font-size-heading-2: 20px;
  --line-height-body: 1.5;
  --line-height-heading: 1.25;
}

/* Base document — the one place we set page colour and the base font. */
html, body { background: var(--color-bg-page); color: var(--color-text-primary); }
body { font-family: var(--font-family-base); font-size: var(--font-size-body); line-height: var(--line-height-body); margin: 0; }
```

Adjust the exact hex values to your taste; the point is that they exist **only here**.

**Create file:** `web/src/shared/i18n/index.tsx`

The reader is deliberately tiny: a context, a provider that sets `document.documentElement.dir` and `lang`, and a `useTranslation()` hook the primitives call. Default language is `en`; the switcher UI is LANGUAGES-1-WEB.

```tsx
import { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useMemo, type ReactNode } from 'react';

import { en } from './en';
import { ar } from './ar';
import type { Messages } from './en';

export type Language = 'en' | 'ar';

const dictionaries: Record<Language, Messages> = { en, ar };
const directions: Record<Language, 'ltr' | 'rtl'> = { en: 'ltr', ar: 'rtl' };

type Ctx = { language: Language; t: Messages; dir: 'ltr' | 'rtl' };
const I18nContext = createContext<Ctx | null>(null);

export function I18nProvider({ language = 'en', children }: { language?: Language; children: ReactNode }) {
  const value = useMemo<Ctx>(
    () => ({ language, t: dictionaries[language], dir: directions[language] }),
    [language],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    // Direction and lang live on <html> so CSS logical properties resolve
    // correctly and screen readers announce the right language.
    const root = document.documentElement;
    root.setAttribute('dir', value.dir);
    root.setAttribute('lang', value.language);
  }, [value]);

  return <I18nContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</I18nContext.Provider>;
}

export function useTranslation(): Ctx {
  const value = useContext(I18nContext);
  if (!value) throw new Error('useTranslation() was called outside I18nProvider');
  return value;
}
```

**File:** `web/src/app/App.tsx` — wrap the tree in `<I18nProvider>` (default `language="en"`) **outside** `AuthProvider` so every child, including sign-in, has translations.

### 4 — Primitives: the smallest set the criteria need

Create one file per primitive under `web/src/shared/ui/`. Each primitive:

- Reads spacing, radius, colour, and type **only** through `var(--…)`.
- Renders semantic HTML (`<button>`, `<input>`, `<label>`, `<h1>`/`<h2>`, `<p>`).
- Uses CSS logical properties for any inline-axis spacing or alignment.
- Exposes a small typed prop surface — no `any`, no `React.CSSProperties` colour passthroughs.
- Ships with a colocated CSS module or a component-scoped CSS file imported by the component (no `.css` string in a `<style>` tag).

Create the following files. Each `.tsx` imports its sibling `.css`.

- `web/src/shared/ui/Button.tsx` + `Button.css` — variants `primary | secondary` (colour from tokens), `type` passthrough, native `<button>`. Padding uses `padding-block` / `padding-inline`.
- `web/src/shared/ui/Input.tsx` + `Input.css` — thin wrapper over `<input>` forwarding refs and standard props. Border, radius, padding from tokens.
- `web/src/shared/ui/Field.tsx` + `Field.css` — composes `<label>` + `Input` + optional `<p class="field-error">`. Uses `--space-1`/`--space-2` for internal spacing. `text-align: start`.
- `web/src/shared/ui/Text.tsx` + `Text.css` — `<p>` at `--font-size-body`; variant `muted` uses `--color-text-muted`.
- `web/src/shared/ui/Heading.tsx` + `Heading.css` — `level: 1 | 2` maps to `<h1>`/`<h2>` and to `--font-size-heading-1`/`--font-size-heading-2`.
- `web/src/shared/ui/Stack.tsx` + `Stack.css` — vertical (default) or horizontal stack via `direction: 'row' | 'column'`, `gap: 1|2|3|4|5|6` maps to `--space-N`. Horizontal stack uses `flex-direction: row` and `column-gap: var(--space-N)`; alignment uses `justify-content` with `start`/`end` (physical `flex-start`/`flex-end` are fine — they respect `dir`).
- `web/src/shared/ui/Card.tsx` + `Card.css` — surface background (`--color-bg-surface`), radius (`--radius-lg`), padding (`--space-5`), border (`--color-border-subtle`).

**Barrel:** `web/src/shared/ui/index.ts` re-exports every primitive so pages import from `'../../shared/ui'`.

**Focus ring:** every interactive primitive (`Button`, `Input`) has `:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; }`. This is the only place `outline` colour is declared.

### 6 — D-1 guard: narrow, grammar-aware CSS scan (web root only)

**Create file:** `web/src/shared/ui/tokens.test.ts`

The check reads every `web/src/**/*.css` **except** `web/src/shared/ui/tokens.css` and asserts that no CSS **declaration value** contains a colour literal. It does not scan `.ts`/`.tsx` (they should not carry raw colour either, but the value of the check is that primitives are enforced through the stylesheet layer; a `.tsx` file that hard-codes a colour would show up in review and, later, in PLATFORM-15-ALL's cross-root script). Cite the two rules and the owner story in a comment at the top.

```ts
// Enforces rule D-1 (scripts/rules.txt line 40) for the web root: no colour
// literal exists in any CSS file except web/src/shared/ui/tokens.css.
//
// The repo-wide version of this check, across api/, web/ and android/, is
// PLATFORM-15-ALL's script — do not extend this test to other roots (L-10, L-13).
//
// Grammar-aware, not a whole-file substring scan: strip /* … */ comments first,
// then match colour syntax only in DECLARATION values (right-hand side of `:`),
// so a comment that mentions #fff does not fail the guard.
import { readFileSync, readdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join, relative, sep } from 'node:path';
import { describe, expect, test } from 'vitest';

const WEB_SRC = new URL('../../', import.meta.url).pathname; // web/src/
const TOKENS = join(WEB_SRC, 'shared/ui/tokens.css');
const COLOR_RE = /#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}\b|\brgba?\s*\(|\bhsla?\s*\(|\b(?:red|blue|green|black|white|gray|grey|yellow|orange|pink|purple|brown|cyan|magenta)\b/;

function walk(dir: string, out: string[] = []): string[] {
  for (const entry of readdirSync(dir)) {
    const full = join(dir, entry);
    const s = statSync(full);
    if (s.isDirectory()) walk(full, out);
    else if (entry.endsWith('.css')) out.push(full);
  }
  return out;
}

function stripComments(css: string): string {
  return css.replace(/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g, '');
}

function declarationValues(css: string): string[] {
  // Match "property: value;" — return values only.
  const out: string[] = [];
  const re = /[a-zA-Z-]+\s*:\s*([^;{}]+);/g;
  let m: RegExpExecArray | null;
  while ((m = re.exec(css))) out.push(m[1]);
  return out;
}

describe('D-1 — colour literals exist only in tokens.css (web root)', () => {
  const files = walk(WEB_SRC).filter((f) => f !== TOKENS);
  test.each(files.map((f) => [relative(WEB_SRC, f).split(sep).join('/'), f]))(
    'no colour literal in %s',
    (_label, file) => {
      const values = declarationValues(stripComments(readFileSync(file, 'utf8')));
      const offenders = values.filter((v) => COLOR_RE.test(v));
      expect(offenders).toEqual([]);
    },
  );
});
```

This guard is scoped to the surface the rule governs and reads CSS grammar (declaration values, comments stripped). It does not scan `.tsx` — that is a review concern this story; a script for the whole tree is PLATFORM-15-ALL's.

## Edge Cases & Failure Modes

- **A primitive imports a colour** — caught structurally: the primitive's CSS file goes through the D-1 guard (task 6). A `.tsx` file that writes `style={{ color: '#fff' }}` bypasses this guard; the fix is a review reject with a link to PLATFORM-15-ALL. Note this trade-off in `tokens.test.ts` header comment.
- **`ar.ts` missing a key that `en.ts` has** — TypeScript will not compile: `ar.ts` declares `export const ar: Messages = { … }`. `npm run build` fails; the suite alone does not (L-15). The verification steps below run the build.
- **A translator adds a key to `en.ts` but forgets `ar.ts`** — same compile failure. Do not use `Partial<Messages>` anywhere.
- **A visitor lands with `<html lang="en">` and never triggers the language provider effect** — mitigated: `I18nProvider` runs its `useEffect` on mount, so `dir` and `lang` are set on the first paint's first frame. Tests assert this (see Test Plan).
- **`document.documentElement.dir` inherited from a previous test** — the direction test explicitly resets it in `beforeEach` and asserts the computed value on the container.
- **Routing tests break because accessible names changed** — mitigated: the primitives must render `<h1>`, `<button>` with the same English strings (`Sign in`, `Support Desk`, `Sign out`). The Test Plan verifies routing.test.tsx still passes unchanged.
- **A second import of `tokens.css`** — no automated guard; call it out in review. The `main.tsx` import is the only one.
- **`system-ui` unavailable on the test runner** — jsdom does not resolve real fonts; the tests assert layout properties and role structure, not typography metrics.
- **A future dark palette** — this story does not add one. `tokens.css` is structured so a `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` or `[data-theme="dark"]` block can override the semantic tokens without touching primitives.
- **`readdirSync` walks `node_modules` or a build folder** — the guard walks only `web/src/`; there is no `dist/` under `src/`.

## Migration / Rollback

- **Behavioural migration:** none — no data, no API surface, no persisted state.
- **Rollback:** revert the commit. The pre-existing pages are unstyled but functional; removing `tokens.css`, the `shared/ui/` folder and the `shared/i18n/` folder plus reverting `main.tsx`, `App.tsx`, `SignInPage.tsx` and `HomePage.tsx` returns the app to CRM-24's state.
- **Half-applied risk:** if only the primitive rewrite lands and the `I18nProvider` is not wired in `App.tsx`, `useTranslation()` throws at render time and the sign-in screen is blank. The `throw new Error('useTranslation() was called outside I18nProvider')` is deliberate — it fails loudly rather than silently rendering `undefined`.

## Verification Steps

1. **Frontend installs:** in `web/`, run `npm install` (only if `package.json` was touched — this story adds no dependencies, so this is a sanity step only).
2. **Frontend typechecks:** in `web/`, run `npm run typecheck`. Must be clean. In particular, `ar.ts` compiling proves the two files carry the same key set.
3. **Frontend suite:** in `web/`, run `npm test`. All existing tests plus the seven new files above pass.
4. **Frontend build (L-15):** in `web/`, run `npm run build`. Must succeed. `vitest` transpiles per file; the build reads the whole graph and catches what the runner does not.
5. **D-1 grep sanity:** in the repo root, run `grep -RInE "#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}|rgb\(|rgba\(|hsl\(|hsla\(" web/src | grep -v "web/src/shared/ui/tokens.css"`. Expect **no output**. This matches the guard's contract and gives a human-readable second opinion.
6. **No `[dir="…"]` overrides:** in the repo root, run `grep -RIn '\[dir=' web/src`. Expect **no output**.
7. **No AI attribution (L-6 scope):** in the repo root, run `grep -RInE "co-?authored|assistant|claude|gpt|copilot" web/src docs api/src` and confirm no matches point at generated attribution in code, docs or commit metadata. `.squad/` is explicitly excluded from this check.
8. **Regression:** `web/src/app/routing.test.tsx` runs unchanged and stays green.
9. **Dev smoke:** in `web/`, run `npm run dev`, load `http://localhost:5173`, sign in with any input, sign out. Then temporarily wire `<I18nProvider language="ar">` in `App.tsx` and confirm the page renders in Arabic with `dir="rtl"` on `<html>` (revert before commit — the runtime switcher is LANGUAGES-1-WEB).

## Done Criteria

- [x] Every colour used in `web/src/` is defined in `web/src/shared/ui/tokens.css` and consumed via `var(--…)`. The D-1 test (`web/src/shared/ui/tokens.test.ts`) passes and reports one case per non-tokens CSS file.
- [x] Every primitive (`Button`, `Input`, `Field`, `Text`, `Heading`, `Stack`, `Card`) exists under `web/src/shared/ui/`, is exported from `web/src/shared/ui/index.ts`, and reads spacing/radius/type from tokens only.
- [x] No `.css` file under `web/src/` contains a `[dir="rtl"]` or `[dir="ltr"]` selector. Direction is expressed with CSS logical properties.
- [x] `web/src/shared/i18n/en.ts` and `web/src/shared/i18n/ar.ts` exist and export the same key set; a missing key in either fails `npm run build`.
- [x] `I18nProvider` sets `document.documentElement.dir` and `lang` from the active language; `useTranslation()` returns the current dictionary.
- [x] `SignInPage` and `HomePage` render entirely through the primitives; their user-visible strings come from the resource files; their English accessible names (`Sign in`, `Support Desk`, `Sign out`) are unchanged.
- [x] `npm run typecheck`, `npm test` and `npm run build` in `web/` all succeed.
- [x] `web/src/app/routing.test.tsx` passes unchanged.
- [x] No new npm dependency added to `web/package.json`.
- [x] Nothing committed in this story's diff mentions AI assistance in code, docs or commit messages.
